summary:
家得寶上季營收與獲利雙雙優於預期，受惠於旺季需求及專業客戶業務穩健成長。
• 每股盈餘達 4.92 美元，優於市場預期的 4.73 美元
• 總營收達 47.86 億美元，較去年同期成長 5.71%
• 專業承包商（Pro）業務維持穩健動能
• 供應鏈效率提升支撐了利潤率表現
ai_view:
觀點：財報展現強韌的營運執行力，優於市場對房市疲軟的擔憂。短中期來看，專業客戶的市佔擴張有助於抵消零售端的遲緩，對股價偏向正面。追蹤指標應關注房貸利率走勢、客單價變化及大型專案支出意願。

需留意：高利率環境持續壓抑大型居家裝修與房市交易動能；總體經濟不確定性可能導致消費者延後非必要支出

summary_en:
Home Depot posted better-than-expected revenue and earnings, driven by strong seasonal demand and steady professional customer growth.
• EPS of $4.92 beat the consensus estimate of $4.73
• Total revenue reached $47.86 billion, up 5.71% year-over-year
• Professional contractor (Pro) segment maintained steady momentum
• Supply chain efficiency improvements supported margin performance

ai_view_en:
View: The earnings demonstrated resilient operational execution, easing market concerns over housing headwinds. In the near to medium term, Pro segment market share gains help offset retail sluggishness, providing a positive bias for the stock. Key metrics to track include mortgage rate trends, average ticket size, and large project spending appetite.

Watch：High interest rate environment continues to pressure large-scale home remodeling and housing turnover; Macroeconomic uncertainty may cause consumers to defer discretionary spending
